scope: current proposed Define-only design and relied-on source/profile boundaries

findings.observed: Six of seven proposed blocks pass original generic frontend parsing. D03 rejects pendingAnswer as a Policy step-name. A five-field PreparationFacts contract is also not declared in the design.
findings.correction: Use selected-profile-compatible simple branch labels; declare and import PreparationFacts and compute it internally from the actual session. A completed private harness with simple labels generated and passed all six decision branches. This does not implement the proposal.
findings.qualification: This is a reproduced failure on the current bounded pure frontend. Other stateful paths may accept different source forms; exact final profile selection remains mandatory.

findings.observed: The index associates missing-field reporting with Query, but its described behavior derives findings from supplied document/schema observations. D06 does not separate check-strategy selection from derived readiness status.
findings.correction: Derive missing fields/revision impact/readiness in Calculations, reusable Boolean predicates in Rules, shape outputs with Mappings, and use Operations for guarding/recording actions. A Policy should select the preparation/check strategy. Reserve Query for retrieving an explicitly stored report/projection with declared keys and source.

findings.target: D02 lookup notes; D05 candidate draft; D07 acknowledgement Queries
findings.observed: Snapshot Value Objects are appropriate, but the proposal does not declare actual Query source Entity/key or authoritative write/replay ownership for new notes and acknowledgements.
findings.correction: Reuse the existing session journal as authoritative history and declare how its current Entity projection exposes new notes. CandidateDraft/Assessment/RevisionPlan remain immutable snapshots unless independent stable lifecycle identity is deliberately selected. No second truth store or unnecessary Entity is required.

findings.kind: public boundary and external observation contracts incomplete
findings.observed: Interface is named for lookup but no complete request/response/capability contract is declared. New commands/read surfaces lack an explicit choice of existing Entry payload versus new Entry and observer/caller attribution.
findings.correction: Complete the bounded-schema Interface and actual source-owner binding. Route new commands through the declared existing protected Entry or specify a new Entry with exact access contract. Distinguish declared local actor from authenticated host actor; source scope/standing/membership observations and acknowledgements cannot be certified by caller assertions.

findings.kind: optional Event not profile- or transaction-bound
findings.observed: D07 lists Event without an actual producer, past-fact payload, receiver, deduplication identity or atomic publication contract. The default authoring profile does not select Event; the separate preparation profile does.
findings.correction: Use a past fact such as HandoffRecorded or AcknowledgementObserved only after durable recording, with source/attempt identity and an explicitly selected Event profile/owner. File-envelope construction can remain pure with no Event. Do not assert atomicity across the CLI file journal and an independent SQLite outbox.

findings.target: new Text and List<Binding,100> fields across D01/D02 and new snapshot types
findings.observed: Shared Text allows 262144 bytes, while selected native value frames are 32768 bytes and input/output are 65536. New evidence arrays and prose fields have no worst-case framing/capacity proof. This is an unqualified design obligation, not a newly observed runtime failure.
findings.correction: Use exact bound document/manifest references for large prose/evidence, bounded pages and capacity guards. Define every referenced technical type and select profiles/source manifests before claiming complete compilation. Preserve full original content without truncation or raising compiler limits.
